added_lemmas.justification: The probability-vector graph preserves all pair-product compatibility constraints and turns loading-body membership, closest-loading loss, and bounded-effect contamination into exact finite real-algebraic problems.
added_lemmas.gap: Pointwise rational diagnostics and low-dimensional pair-mass inverses do not decide membership or optimize contamination on every exceptional finite-support stratum.
added_lemmas.consumer: The OpenTable state-of-emergency analysis and public reshaped inverse-probability workflow can return an exact feasible law or a certified closest loading with its worst-case bounded-effect contamination.
